item.title: PromeFTP 1.1.9
item.description:
Optional automatic host key trust and OTP-friendly agent sessions

Each bookmark can let agents trust new or changed host keys without asking, with a clear warning. Agents also wait properly while you enter a one-time password.

  • Automatic host key trust
    Choose off, new keys only, or new and changed keys for each bookmark. Turning it on shows a warning, and every automatic trust is recorded.
  • Stale known_hosts entries
    An old key in ~/.ssh/known_hosts or /etc/ssh no longer stops a connection before PromeFTP can ask.
  • More time for one-time passwords
    A prompt extends the authentication limit to 3 minutes, and agents can wait for the session with promeftp session wait.
  • Clearer agent guidance
    Status responses and the agent skill explain how to keep a session open and what to do after it ends.

Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
